description: Telangana government aims to train 2 lakh AI engineers, establish AI University, and promote industrial development in the state.
body_lead: Telangana government is pursuing an ambitious goal of training two lakh Artificial Intelligence (AI) engineers, IT and Industries Minister Duddilla Sridhar Babu said on Monday (April 7, 2025). To seize employment opportunities in emerging technologies space Mentioning this during the interaction with a delegation led by Singapore Consul General Edgar Pang that called on him at the State Secretariat in Hyderabad, the Minister said the government’s emphasis is on equipping the State’s youth with skills required to seize employment opportunities in the emerging technologies space.
